test_title: PYST 25: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Which of the following sentences contains the ANTONYM of the word ‘important’?

options.text: Choose the right colour to make your bike stand out!
Namita also makes some very salient points in her newly revised preface.
I have some urgent questions for you.
You always make me do all the trivial stuff.

solution: The correct answer is **Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"important"** means something of great significance or value. (महत्वपूर्ण) • **Example: **It is** important** to attend the meeting on time. • **"Trivial" **refers to something of little value or importance; not significant. (तुच्छ) • **Example: **She was upset over a **trivial** matter that didn't really affect anything. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: Choose the right colour to make your bike stand out!** (अपनी बाइक को अलग दिखाने के लिए सही रंग चुनें!) • **Explanation:** This sentence talks about choosing a colour to make the bike noticeable, which is unrelated to importance. • **Option 2: Namita also makes some very salient points in her newly revised preface.** (नमिता अपने नए संशोधित प्राक्कथन में कुछ बहुत महत्वपूर्ण बातें भी करती हैं।) • **Explanation:** The word **"salient"** means important or prominent, which is a synonym rather than an antonym of **"important".** • **Option 3: I have some urgent questions for you.** (मेरे पास आपके लिए कुछ आवश्यक प्रश्न हैं।) • **Explanation:** The word **"urgent"** implies something that needs immediate attention and is important, not the opposite of important. 39:Tc27, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
